title: The same habits can cross a boundary
label: Authority
description: A familiar request to change the goal can come from a user or a peer. The missing distinction is who has authority to replace the goal.
visual: A trajectory with a violation, separated by an observation boundary from a recorded PASS.

title: Alignment has to shape the combinations
label: Alignment
description: Training reshapes shared behavior. Passing selected tests does not establish how the intended boundary holds in other consequential situations.
visual: Checked evaluation points on a contour map, with a dashed path toward an untested situation.

title: The hive can replace the queen
label: Connected agents
description: Connect several models, and a new question appears: whose goal is the group serving?
visual: Three separate contour maps connected by communication arrows and a shared hub.

title: What I would build differently
label: Safeguards
description: Signed delegation and enforced event records let us cap activity and trace possible exposure across agents, without mistaking provenance for alignment.
visual: A request leaving a learned policy is stopped by a separate authorization gate.

title: Every agent can pass the test. The queen can still be replaced.
label: Conclusion
description: Test the collective, not just the individuals, and put authority where the network can't reinterpret it.
visual: A path on a contour map branches toward three open questions.
